title: Deciding Bodies and Effect of Decisions: Appeals and Grievances Case Types
content:
For each **Appeals and Grievances** case type, the body that decides, whether a resolved plan appeal must come first, whether an unresolved plan appeal past its due date counts as exhausted, when the plan's case summary is due, whether a decision against the plan binds it, how quickly an overturn is put into effect, and whether action against a member for filing is prohibited, are as follows.

| Case type | Body that decides | Resolved plan appeal required before filing | Plan appeal unresolved by its due date counts as exhausted | Plan case summary sent within (calendar days after the filed date) | Decision against the plan binds it | Service authorized or provided within (hours after an overturn) | Action against the member for filing prohibited |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Member Grievance | Plan grievance unit | No | No | 0 (not applicable) | No | 0 (not applicable) | Yes |
| Quality of Care Grievance | Plan quality committee | No | No | 0 (not applicable) | No | 0 (not applicable) | Yes |
| Standard Appeal | Plan appeals unit | No | No | 0 (not applicable) | Yes | 72 | Yes |
| Expedited Appeal | Plan appeals unit | No | No | 0 (not applicable) | Yes | 72 | Yes |
| State Fair Hearing | State hearing office | Yes | Yes | 10 | Yes | 72 | Yes |
| External Medical Review | Independent review organization | Yes | No | 5 | Yes | 72 | Yes |

## Statement by body

- **Plan grievance unit** decides a Member Grievance, and the **plan quality committee** a Quality of Care Grievance. Neither case type requires a prior plan appeal, carries a case summary to an outside body or has an overturn period, and a decision on either does not bind the plan.
- **Plan appeals unit** decides a Standard Appeal and an Expedited Appeal. A decision against the plan binds it, and an overturned service is authorized or provided within 72 hours.
- **State hearing office** decides a State Fair Hearing. A resolved plan appeal is required first, a plan appeal not resolved by its due date counts as exhausted, the plan's case summary is due within 10 calendar days of the filed date, the decision binds the plan and an overturn is effected within 72 hours.
- **Independent review organization** decides an External Medical Review. A resolved plan appeal is required first and a plan appeal past its due date does not count as exhausted; the plan's case summary is due within 5 calendar days of the filed date, the decision binds the plan and an overturn is effected within 72 hours.
- On all six case types, any action against the member for filing is prohibited.
